text:
elena: Noticed a bunch of 404s in the analytics for deep links into the migration guide. Example: /migration/v2#setup (there's a hidden null char in the fragment). Customer hit it from a partner blog.

chris: interesting. null bytes sometimes sneak in during copy/paste from MS Word or PDFs. browser silently drops them but our slugifier and linkcheck behave differently. can you share the failing URL?

elena: here's the raw link user sent (copied): `https://docs.redwood.ai/migration/v2#setup�`

mohit: yep that's a trailing NUL. quick fix: add a normalization step in the link generator that strips control chars from fragments and update docs to use explicit ids on top-level headings. also file a small PR to clean the affected pages.

elena: i'll scrub the three affected docs (migration/v2, guides/upgrade, and quickstart) and add explicit ids to the headings. i'll open a PR with the cleanup + linkcheck normalization.

link-bot: New issue created: GH-7212 "Normalize link fragments, strip control chars"

mohit: For the linkcheck step, we should also canonicalize fragments before comparing: `python -c "import unicodedata,sys;print(''.join(ch for ch in sys.stdin.read() if ord(ch)>31))"` might help. but better to use `str.isprintable()` utils.

ci-bot: PR #3720 opened by @elena: migration fragment scrub + link normalization. Running `yarn docs:linkcheck` and `mkdocs build --strict`.

ci-bot: Linkcheck found matching anchors but flagged 2 pages with non-printable characters in heading text (migration/v2.md and quickstart.md). Failing to avoid regressions.

chris: Thanks CI. @elena can you update the patch to replace non-printable chars in headings and add explicit ids e.g. `## Setup {#setup}`? Also a short README note in docs/CONTRIBUTING.md about avoiding copy/paste from Word/PDF please.

elena: Updated PR: replaced headings, removed stray control bytes, added explicit ids, and extended linkcheck to normalize fragments before comparison. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3720

ci-bot: Re-running linkcheck on PR #3720... All checks passed. Duplicate/garbage fragment checks clear.

mohit: Merged commit a1d9f3c. Added a tiny unit in the linkcheck job that asserts `all(c.isprintable() for c in fragment)` after slug generation.

elena: :tada: verified partner link now lands correctly. i'll run a repo-wide grep for `` and other control codes and open separate tidy PRs for any findings.

chris: Good catch. I'll add a blurb to the migration guide: "Avoid pasting headings from Word/PDF; run `tr -d '\000'` on pasted content or add explicit heading ids."

elena: closing loop. Ping here if anyone sees weird deep links.
